single_worker.implemented: Both shared-input and worker-local batch helpers run one worker directly on the caller thread. Setup remains outside the timer, measured duration is returned before retained-input destruction, and operation panics still become benchmark errors. threads.execution records caller versus spawned and updates with Suite::thread_count. Inherited and CLI-selected one-worker callbacks now use local borrowed-input adapters when argument/executor captures are not Sync. threads.local_only marks this path; later Suite::thread_count greater than one rejects before changing any entry. Inherited setup fallback now supports one-worker sync borrowed/owned non-Send inputs and outputs, plus async borrowed/owned local captures. Owned async fallback transfers each prepared Option input once and preserves owned-drop contracts. Explicit thread attributes now use the same local dispatch for supported plain/setup cases without custom measurement, allocator, explicit batch or setup_thread overrides. One-worker local cases compile; larger incompatible counts produce registration errors before execution.
single_worker.upstream: Divan 0.1.21 src/benchmark/mod.rs:586 guarantees closures stay on current thread for one worker. Multiple workers use caller plus auxiliary workers; Airbug still spawns all workers when count exceeds one.

worker_capacity.implemented: Fallible reservation for shared prepared inputs, scoped join handles, completed inputs and allocation-result vectors. The 256-worker ceiling is removed from automatic selection, attribute registration, CLI parsing, Suite validation, both batch executors and workloads::parallel. scalar_cli_followup.status: 123 boundary/precedence checks passed through a real Cargo-built attribute harness on macOS ARM64

domains.samples_and_iterations: Unsigned u64; zero disables. Values above u32 and u64::MAX survive preview exactly; u64 overflow and negatives rejected.
domains.resamples: Positive usize; 1 and 1000001 accepted; zero, negatives and u64 overflow rejected on tested 64-bit host. Full capacity behavior remains covered by library tests.
domains.confidence_and_significance: Finite strict (0,1), including smallest positive subnormal and predecessor of 1; zero, one, negatives, NaN and infinity rejected.
domains.noise_threshold: Finite nonnegative percent, including 0, 250 and f64::MAX. Criterion expresses fractions and its setter also admits positive infinity; Airbug deliberately rejects nonfinite thresholds. Finite fraction-to-percent multiplication can overflow at extreme values; identical syntax/domain is not claimed.
domains.time: Exact decimal milliseconds. Zero accepted for warmup/min/max; positive sample/measurement target required. 1 ns and Duration::MAX preserved as exact integer nanoseconds in case contracts; negative, nonfinite, sub-nanosecond and overflowing values rejected. Divan ParsedSeconds uses Duration::try_from_secs_f64; Criterion CLI also parses f64 seconds. Native decimal spelling avoids float rounding.
domains.counters: Bytes/items/chars/cycles/bits accept 0 through u64::MAX and survive contract preview exactly; negatives/overflow/non-numeric values rejected. Divan MaxCountUInt is condtype::num::Usize64 on supported 64-bit hosts.
